% Original analytic teaching diagram, 2026-11-12.
% Omega = [0,1). Atoms of the sigma-algebras generated by D1 (first binary digit), D2 (second digit),
% K = floor(4 omega) and floor(8 omega). Each cell shows the observed value; sigma(D1) and sigma(D2) are both
% contained in sigma(K), which is contained in sigma(floor(8 omega)); sigma(D1) and sigma(D2) are not nested.
\definecolor{VB}{HTML}{7188A3}\definecolor{VBF}{HTML}{E5EAF0}
\definecolor{VG}{HTML}{829C8B}\definecolor{VGF}{HTML}{E8EEE9}
\definecolor{VY}{HTML}{B4A16F}\definecolor{VYF}{HTML}{F1ECDD}
\definecolor{VR}{HTML}{A7787D}\definecolor{VRF}{HTML}{F0E5E6}
\definecolor{VP}{HTML}{9588A5}\definecolor{VPF}{HTML}{ECE8F0}
\definecolor{VI}{HTML}{3B4252}\definecolor{VM}{HTML}{6B7280}\definecolor{VL}{HTML}{4C4D4F}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1mm,y=1mm,>=Stealth,font=\figurefont\fontsize{8}{10}\selectfont,
lab/.style={text=VM,font=\figurefont\fontsize{7.5}{9}\selectfont},
num/.style={text=VI,font=\figurefont\fontsize{7}{8}\selectfont}]
\def\L{80}
% \row{y}{number of cells}{list of values}
\newcommand{\row}[3]{
  \foreach \v [count=\i from 0] in {#3} {
    \pgfmathsetmacro{\a}{\L*\i/#2}\pgfmathsetmacro{\b}{\L*(\i+1)/#2}
    \pgfmathtruncatemacro{\odd}{mod(\v,2)}
    \ifnum\odd=1 \fill[VBF] (\a,#1) rectangle (\b,{#1+5}); \fi
    \draw[VL,line width=.45pt] (\a,#1) rectangle (\b,{#1+5});
    \node[num] at ({(\a+\b)/2},{#1+2.5}) {\v};
  }
}
\row{27}{2}{0,1}
\node[anchor=east,text=VI] at (-2,29.5) {$D_1$};
\row{19}{4}{0,1,0,1}
\node[anchor=east,text=VI] at (-2,21.5) {$D_2$};
\row{11}{4}{0,1,2,3}
\node[anchor=east,text=VI] at (-2,13.5) {$K=\lfloor4\omega\rfloor$};
\row{3}{8}{0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}
\node[anchor=east,text=VI] at (-2,5.5) {$\lfloor8\omega\rfloor$};
\draw[VL,line width=.6pt] (0,0) -- (\L,0);
\foreach \x/\t in {0/0,0.25/{1/4},0.5/{1/2},0.75/{3/4},1/1} {
  \draw[VL,line width=.6pt] ({\L*\x},0) -- ({\L*\x},1);
  \node[below,text=VI] at ({\L*\x},-.3) {$\t$};
}
\node[anchor=west,text=VI] at ({\L+2},0) {$\omega$};
\end{tikzpicture}
